_comment: Expected DE-301 fill for case.split.json — applicant != appointee scenario. Critical contrast with filled.example.json: applicant_full_legal_name and person_whose_appointment_is_sought hold DIFFERENT values.
_critical_difference_from_example: In case.example.json, applicant=appointee → both fields hold 'Margaret L. Crawford-Hines'. Here, applicant=Rebecca M. Tilton (sister), appointee=Bath Savings Trust Company. The pipeline must NOT propagate applicant_full_legal_name into person_whose_appointment_is_sought. The signature and notary fields STILL trace to the applicant (Rebecca) because she is the affiant.

fields.person_whose_appointment_is_sought: Bath Savings Trust Company, by James L. Hartwell, Trust Officer
fields.will_details: Will dated 2009-07-12 with codicils dated 2014-03-08 and 2019-11-22; both codicils witnessed and self-proved.

equals_field(applicant_full_legal_name,: applicant_signature_name='Rebecca M. Tilton' vs applicant_full_legal_name='Rebecca M. Tilton' → passes (applicant signed her own petition)
notary_appearer_name='Rebecca M. Tilton' vs applicant_full_legal_name='Rebecca M. Tilton' → passes (applicant appeared before notary)

NOTE: person_whose_appointment_is_sought is NOT checked against applicant_full_legal_name — that would incorrectly fail this case. The encoded validators correctly distinguish 'who signs' (applicant) from 'who serves' (appointee).
_validator_expectations.value_in(yes, no): (if encoded) domiciled_in_county=yes, will_presented_for_probate=yes, nominated_as_pr_in_will=no → all pass

_what_would_fail_if_pipeline_is_wrong.auto-duplication bug: If pipeline naively copies applicant_full_legal_name into person_whose_appointment_is_sought, the fill would show 'Rebecca M. Tilton' there — wrong, and would mislead the court into appointing the sister instead of the corporate trustee.
_what_would_fail_if_pipeline_is_wrong.missed nominated_as_pr_in_will branch: If LLM doesn't pick up that the will's named PR predeceased, it might check 'nominated_as_pr_in_will=yes' incorrectly.
_what_would_fail_if_pipeline_is_wrong.wrong signature flow: If pipeline writes 'Bath Savings Trust Company' in applicant_signature_name (because that's the appointee), equals_field would fail — correctly catching the bug.
